ptbDkGB08q.method: The framework identifies biological component subspaces in frozen genomic models and evaluates their interactions against established RNA-splicing rules. It compares biological rule faithfulness rankings with independent experimental measurements when conventional rankings disagree.
ptbDkGB08q.key_idea: Identify component subspaces in frozen genomic representations and score whether their interactions obey experimentally established biological rules.
ptbDkGB08q.evidence: RNA-splicing analyses cover six models with different architectures and pretraining strategies, with ranking checks against independent published experimental measurements.
ptbDkGB08q.claimed_gains: Biological rule faithfulness favors the better-performing model in 57.1–88.9% of evaluated comparisons with conflicting rankings.

siEm5TmOO0.one_liner: Entropy lower bounds and regression reconstruction attacks locate a privacy-budget transition governed by effective data dimension.
siEm5TmOO0.problem: Differential privacy lacks clear guidance on how large privacy budgets can become before accurate training-sample reconstruction becomes feasible.
siEm5TmOO0.method: The analysis considers an informed attacker reconstructing one sample from a zero-concentrated differentially private model while knowing all other data. It combines entropy-based impossibility bounds with an attack on output-perturbed private linear regression.
siEm5TmOO0.key_idea: Compare entropy-based reconstruction lower bounds with private-regression attacks to identify the transition as privacy budget reaches effective data dimension.
siEm5TmOO0.evidence: Theory establishes a reconstruction transition at privacy budgets of order d for specified target priors, shifting to order s for data in an s-dimensional subspace.

UpJ7hHcWUf.one_liner: Distance-resolved input influence separates architectural reach, learned information use, approximation limits, and numerical effects in GNNs.
UpJ7hHcWUf.problem: Architectural connectivity to distant nodes does not establish that a GNN learns or preserves task-relevant long-range information.
UpJ7hHcWUf.method: The framework measures how inputs at each graph distance influence predictions and separates architectural, finite-approximation, training, and numerical limitations. It analyzes influence propagation and differences between mathematically equivalent filters.
UpJ7hHcWUf.key_idea: Measure prediction sensitivity by graph distance and decompose failures across architecture, approximation, learning, and numerical execution.
UpJ7hHcWUf.evidence: Theory and controlled tasks show that similarly connected GNNs use distant inputs differently and that low average error can conceal distant-interaction failures.

XywNH2Ca3U.one_liner: P²O alternates policy updates with hard-query prompt evolution and distills prompted trajectories back into the original query.
XywNH2Ca3U.problem: Identical rollout rewards collapse group advantages, especially on hard queries where larger rollout budgets provide little benefit.
XywNH2Ca3U.method: P²O mines hard samples by success rate, evolves reasoning prompts with GEPA, and alternates prompt evolution with policy updates. Context distillation trains trajectories under original queries, while a Context Ratio Mask filters extreme likelihood ratios.
XywNH2Ca3U.key_idea: Evolve prompts for hard queries, then internalize the elicited trajectories through context distillation under the original unprompted queries.
XywNH2Ca3U.evidence: Experiments compare with GRPO, DAPO, and other baselines across training datasets and backbones on six held-out benchmarks, including AIME24 and AIME25.
XywNH2Ca3U.claimed_gains: P²O exceeds GRPO by up to 8.2 points in average accuracy on six held-out benchmarks and 16.3 points averaged across AIME24 and AIME25.

SLMOUUr6Il.one_liner: A procedure-consistency firewall checks temporal memory provenance, while a reliability-gated writer prevents contaminated surgical-video states from propagating.
SLMOUUr6Il.problem: Temporal memory from incompatible procedural contexts can corrupt current surgical segmentation and recursively contaminate future states.
SLMOUUr6Il.method: The annotation-free inference-time firewall compares the current frame's procedure distribution with the provenance distribution attached to memory. A Trustworthy Memory Writer updates trusted memory only when the resulting state is sufficiently reliable.
SLMOUUr6Il.key_idea: Gate memory by procedural-distribution compatibility and gate memory updates by state reliability.
SLMOUUr6Il.evidence: A controlled suite of temporal interventions tests provenance mismatch, clean conditions, core stress, and worst-case segmentation Dice.
SLMOUUr6Il.claimed_gains: The method improves robustness under core stress by 6.31% and worst-case Dice by 32.77%.

KGShJUWHMf.one_liner: SilHand projects metric 3D hand hypotheses into calibrated views and fuses binary-mask evidence for synthetic-to-real reconstruction.
KGShJUWHMf.problem: Real hand-capture data is costly and limited, while appearance differences obstruct transfer from scalable synthetic supervision.
KGShJUWHMf.method: SilHand reconstructs hands from binary masks instead of RGB features. It projects metric 3D hypotheses into calibrated views and queries and fuses mask-ray evidence after training on synthetic hand geometry.
KGShJUWHMf.key_idea: Use calibrated binary silhouettes to query and fuse projected 3D hypotheses, reducing dependence on synthetic-to-real appearance matching.
KGShJUWHMf.evidence: Training uses 46.8k grasping poses and 60k free-hand samples, with evaluation on five real-world benchmarks using masks rendered from reference hands.
KGShJUWHMf.claimed_gains: SilHand improves relative reconstruction accuracy from 49.2% to 63.4% using masks rendered from reference hands.

hFEngp5WHJ.one_liner: X-WAM adds depth prediction to video diffusion and jointly samples noise levels to support asynchronous action and world generation.
hFEngp5WHJ.problem: Prior unified world models focus on 2D pixels and struggle to balance action-decoding efficiency with world-modeling quality.
hFEngp5WHJ.method: X-WAM predicts multi-view RGB-D video, replicating final Diffusion Transformer blocks into a depth branch for spatial reconstruction. Asynchronous Noise Sampling draws joint noise levels covering asynchronous inference conditions to train action and world generation together.
hFEngp5WHJ.key_idea: Adapt video diffusion with a depth branch and jointly sample action-world noise levels matching asynchronous inference.
hFEngp5WHJ.evidence: After pretraining on over 5,800 hours of robotic data, X-WAM is evaluated on RoboCasa and RoboTwin 2.0 for action success and 4D generation.
hFEngp5WHJ.claimed_gains: X-WAM achieves 79.2% and 90.7% average success rate on RoboCasa and RoboTwin 2.0, respectively.

GWRfMHcXWA.one_liner: HiLo-WAM separates sparse long-horizon visual states from dense local dynamics and connects both streams to actions through attention.
GWRfMHcXWA.problem: Modeling long-range state evolution and local interactions in one trajectory entangles their representations and action dependencies.
GWRfMHcXWA.method: HiLo-WAM uses a sparse stream for history and future task states and a dense stream for short-horizon interactions. Structured cross-stream attention links both to actions, with selective denoising and feature reuse for progressive inference.
GWRfMHcXWA.key_idea: Represent long-range state and short-range dynamics in separate temporal streams linked to actions by structured attention.
GWRfMHcXWA.evidence: Experiments span simulation benchmarks and long-horizon real-world tasks, including RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and RoboDojo's five capability dimensions.
GWRfMHcXWA.claimed_gains: HiLo-WAM achieves 93.92% average success on RoboTwin 2.0, 97.6% on LIBERO, and 22.70 average progress with 16.82% success on RoboDojo.

YiaT7gUNdT.one_liner: Momentum-based analysis establishes constant-batch convergence and improved dimension dependence for sign-based optimization, including distributed settings.
YiaT7gUNdT.problem: Prior sign-based convergence guarantees require large batches or restrictive noise assumptions and have weaker dimension dependence.
YiaT7gUNdT.method: The paper analyzes signSGD with momentum under separable and l2 smoothness and extends sign-based methods to distributed settings. It establishes constant-batch rates without the additional unimodal symmetric-noise assumptions used in earlier analyses.
YiaT7gUNdT.key_idea: Use momentum in sign-based updates to establish convergence with constant batches and sharper dimension-dependent rates.
YiaT7gUNdT.evidence: Theoretical guarantees cover separable smoothness, l2 smoothness, and distributed optimization, with numerical experiments validating the methods.
YiaT7gUNdT.claimed_gains: The analysis gives O(T^{-1/4}) with constant batches, an O(d^{1/2}) improvement under l2 smoothness, and distributed rates O(d^{1/2}T^{-1/2} + dn^{-1/2}) and O(d^{1/4}T^{-1/4}).

Ox9DSPL87u.one_liner: RODS augments scarce grading labels with synthetic responses, consistency-based optimization, and adversarial sample-quality control.
Ox9DSPL87u.problem: Automatic rubric optimization is limited by scarce annotated student responses.
Ox9DSPL87u.method: RODS synthesizes supplementary student responses and uses consistency-based optimization to reduce synthetic-label noise. Generative adversarial quality control aligns samples with real responses, while iterative optimization combines synthetic and human-labeled data.
Ox9DSPL87u.key_idea: Optimize rubrics using synthetic and real responses with consistency checks and adversarial controls on synthetic sample quality.
Ox9DSPL87u.evidence: Experiments on multiple automatic-grading datasets report improved rubric quality and grading accuracy under limited-label settings.

snI2KIKKzH.one_liner: CoRe combines distribution-aware sampling, coarse-to-fine prediction, and multimodal graphs for few-shot sentiment regression.
snI2KIKKzH.problem: Few-shot sentiment regression struggles with unrepresentative sentiment distributions, pretrained models' numerical limitations, and point-wise losses that neglect distributional discrepancies.
snI2KIKKzH.method: CoRe samples examples to approximate the global sentiment distribution and progressively refines affective semantics into continuous predictions using a heterogeneous multimodal graph. A distance-aware objective aligns predicted distributions with soft targets.
snI2KIKKzH.key_idea: Sample a representative sentiment distribution, refine semantic predictions through a multimodal graph, and align predicted distributions with distance-aware soft targets.

kuaCY9CqsP.one_liner: GEWorld initializes, assimilates, and rolls out latent physiological states to predict crop traits under changing environments.
kuaCY9CqsP.problem: Static genotype-to-phenotype mappings struggle to incorporate new observations and changing environmental conditions.
kuaCY9CqsP.method: GEWorld initializes a physiological state through gated genotype-environment interactions, updates it with a GRU observation module, and rolls it forward through a Mamba-2-inspired transition. It decodes terminal traits and dynamic trajectories and evaluates alternative weather futures from the same assimilated state.
kuaCY9CqsP.key_idea: Fuse genotype and environment into a latent state, correct it with observed phenotypes, and evolve it under future environmental inputs.
kuaCY9CqsP.evidence: Static and dynamic benchmarks spanning five crops assess predictive accuracy and agreement between forecasted trajectories and observed development.

rrYnrso7F8.one_liner: GSTAR scales product-quantization groups with spatial compression and models their dependencies through semi-autoregressive decoding.
rrYnrso7F8.problem: Long visual token sequences slow autoregressive generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity.
rrYnrso7F8.method: GSTAR scales group size quadratically with per-axis spatial compression under a fixed nominal information budget. Its semi-autoregressive decoder combines parallel feature computation with lightweight causal modeling of intra-group dependencies.
rrYnrso7F8.key_idea: Increase product-quantization group size quadratically with spatial compression and decode intra-group dependencies using parallel features and lightweight causal modeling.
rrYnrso7F8.evidence: Evaluation covers GenEval, DPG-Bench, PRISM, LongText-Bench, and Qwen-Image-Bench, with generation latency measured on a single NVIDIA H200.
rrYnrso7F8.claimed_gains: GSTAR enables 32x and effective 64x compression and delivers a 20x speedup at 1024x1024 resolution, generating each image in 2.5 seconds on a single NVIDIA H200.

lcJyOrWTB1.one_liner: AhJEPA applies reconstruction loss to CLS tokens in a shared-backbone JEPA framework to learn fine-grained relationships.
lcJyOrWTB1.problem: Regularization-based self-supervised methods do not sufficiently encourage fine-grained relationships needed for downstream tasks.
lcJyOrWTB1.method: AhJEPA combines contextual prediction under distribution regularization with CLS-token reconstruction in a single branch without a separate teacher or EMA updates. The final method retains stop-gradient for its empirical performance.
lcJyOrWTB1.key_idea: Apply reconstruction supervision to CLS tokens within a shared-backbone contextual prediction framework while retaining stop-gradient.
lcJyOrWTB1.evidence: The TL;DR reports improvements across classification, segmentation, depth estimation, and latent world-model planning.

36cnc26Js4.one_liner: Looped-DiT repeatedly applies shared Transformer blocks with intermediate supervision and self-modulating attention within each denoising step.
36cnc26Js4.problem: Naive looping in diffusion Transformers suffers from weak intermediate supervision and attention updates that erode local information.
36cnc26Js4.method: Looped-DiT increases computational depth by reusing Transformer blocks within each denoising step. Deep supervision across loops and self-modulating attention stabilize iterative feature refinement.
36cnc26Js4.key_idea: Reuse Transformer blocks within denoising steps while supervising intermediate loops and regulating their attention updates.
36cnc26Js4.evidence: Text-to-image experiments compare looped and non-looped models under matched-parameter and matched-compute settings across multiple unspecified benchmarks.
36cnc26Js4.claimed_gains: A 260M-parameter looped model surpasses a model 6.5× larger while requiring 4.9× lower inference compute.

Wp830Y8dnz.one_liner: EgoExplorer combines wearable multimodal capture with calibrated, temporally completed, constrained motion reconstruction for human loco-manipulation.
Wp830Y8dnz.problem: Existing human demonstration datasets incompletely capture the coordination of locomotion, posture, and object interaction.
Wp830Y8dnz.method: EgoExplorer aligns egocentric video, whole-body motion, finger articulation, tactile observations, and step-level descriptions. Its Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline fixes geometry and sensor attachments, fills unobserved motion with a temporal prior, and enforces measurement, temporal, and geometric consistency.
Wp830Y8dnz.key_idea: Calibrate participant geometry and sensor mounts before motion inference, complete missing joints with a temporal prior, and impose layered consistency constraints.
Wp830Y8dnz.evidence: A 100-hour wearable dataset accompanies comparisons against tracker-fitted references and matched evaluations of hand stability and contact estimation.
Wp830Y8dnz.claimed_gains: The method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline against tracker-fitted references.

iKcjx0dpG5.one_liner: Scaling laws account for limited semantic uniqueness using gradient alignment, embedding collisions, and repeated-document pretraining experiments.
iKcjx0dpG5.problem: Deduplication and naive scaling extrapolations overlook how semantic redundancy depends on model capability and corpus size.
iKcjx0dpG5.method: The study measures gradient alignment for semantically equivalent documents, nearest-neighbor embedding gaps, and pretraining losses under repeated sampling. It derives scaling laws that incorporate limited semantic uniqueness.
iKcjx0dpG5.key_idea: Model duplication as capability-dependent semantic redundancy and incorporate finite semantic uniqueness into pretraining scaling laws.
iKcjx0dpG5.evidence: Experiments embed 192 million FineWeb-Edu-Dedup documents with EmbeddingGemma-300m and compare controlled pretraining with replacement across model scales.

sF70kBTBO3.one_liner: PrismQ allocates low-rank reconstruction capacity and cached calibration tokens according to layer- and precision-dependent quantization errors.
sF70kBTBO3.problem: Elastic quantization must balance shared versus precision-specific reconstruction capacity while controlling memory for precision-dependent calibration states.
sF70kBTBO3.method: PrismRank estimates reconstruction demand from clipping-error singular values, and PrismLoRA implements allocations through shared and precision-specific low-rank components. Calibration-only Sparse Token selects quantized token states by error under a fixed cache budget for subsequent blocks.
sF70kBTBO3.key_idea: Allocate low-rank reconstruction components using clipping-error spectra and propagate selected quantized token states according to token-wise error.

a2acp5WMTl.one_liner: SETUPX reuses calibrated setup experiences, snapshot-backed repair execution, and independent verification to configure functional code repositories.
a2acp5WMTl.problem: Repository setup agents lack cross-repository memory, safe recovery from state-changing repairs, and verification that distinguishes setup failures from repository defects.
a2acp5WMTl.method: SETUPX distills prior setup trajectories into a structured, outcome-calibrated experience store. It combines this memory with LIFO snapshot-backed speculative execution and a Prosecutor–Judge verification protocol.
a2acp5WMTl.key_idea: Reuse outcome-calibrated setup trajectories, roll back speculative repairs through LIFO snapshots, and audit functionality with a Prosecutor–Judge protocol.
a2acp5WMTl.evidence: Evaluation uses a curated 100-repository benchmark with a frozen experience store and 22 multi-repository workflows.
a2acp5WMTl.claimed_gains: SETUPX achieves a 92% pass rate, a 19-percentage-point gain over the strongest external baseline (73%) and a 10-percentage-point gain over its no-XPU variant (82%); across 22 workflows, Full+Mostly completion matches at 16/22 while Full readiness is $6\times$ higher (6/22 vs. 1/22).

ajniGci2l0.one_liner: TrawMem organizes interaction histories into threads and selects complementary memories by their task-specific roles and relations.
ajniGci2l0.problem: Query relevance alone misses memories whose task-specific roles or connections provide necessary complementary information.
ajniGci2l0.method: TrawMem organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces. It assigns memory roles and jointly selects complementary memories according to their relations.
ajniGci2l0.key_idea: Assign task-dependent roles to memories and jointly select complementary items from locally organized interaction threads.
ajniGci2l0.evidence: Experiments evaluate LoCoMo and MemGallery with four open- and closed-source backbones against representative memory systems.
ajniGci2l0.claimed_gains: Macro-F1 gains are 2.23--3.14 points; on LoCoMo, LLM-Judge scores exceed SimpleMem by 4.07 and 4.31 percentage points on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, respectively, with approximately 12.8% and 5.1% fewer context tokens.

NgFXsZc2Kk.one_liner: RSE-Bench injects ordinary noise during agent skill learning and evaluates frozen skill stores on held-out tasks.
NgFXsZc2Kk.problem: Existing evaluations inadequately test whether non-adversarial errors in experience persist through agent skill self-evolution.
NgFXsZc2Kk.method: RSE-Bench perturbs instructions, environmental evidence, execution records, and outcome-record pairings while preserving tasks and native scoring. RSEClaw standardizes noise injection and diagnoses exposure and skill updates while separating learning-time noise from evaluation input noise.
NgFXsZc2Kk.key_idea: Perturb experience during skill acquisition, freeze the resulting skill stores, and measure transfer to held-out tasks separately from evaluation-time noise.
NgFXsZc2Kk.evidence: The benchmark spans four domains and six benchmarks, with experiments across three methods and two backbones.
NgFXsZc2Kk.claimed_gains: Noisy learning retains only $25.5\%$--$42.1\%$ of the aggregate gain from clean self-evolution, depending on noise type.

ca865DhnmA.one_liner: OmniaBench constructs executable agent environments and tasks from a hierarchical application taxonomy with explicit state spaces.
ca865DhnmA.problem: Agent benchmarks cover limited scenarios, tools, and interaction formats, hindering evaluation across heterogeneous applications.
ca865DhnmA.method: OmniaBench derives a scenario taxonomy from application and industry sources with human refinement, then synthesizes single-turn and multi-turn tasks through DAG, DAG-S, Solver, and Program routes. Capability dimensions and compositional difficulty factors support fine-grained analysis.
ca865DhnmA.key_idea: Generate executable tasks within explicit state spaces from a hierarchical scenario taxonomy and annotate capability and difficulty dimensions.
ca865DhnmA.evidence: The benchmark includes 1,431 tasks and a 644-task challenging subset across a taxonomy of 90 level-1 and 354 level-2 domains.

g6lX6r2LhO.one_liner: CoDev-Bench tests coding agents on composing independently authored concurrent pull requests that share a base commit.
g6lX6r2LhO.problem: Single-issue coding benchmarks omit the integration challenges of concurrent development within a shared codebase.
g6lX6r2LhO.method: CoDev-Bench pairs naturally concurrent pull requests branching from the same commit. It evaluates a single agent handling both requests, separate agents followed by merging, and a main agent delegating subtasks.
g6lX6r2LhO.key_idea: Evaluate joint resolution of independently authored pull-request pairs with a common base and subsequent integration into the main branch.
g6lX6r2LhO.evidence: Evaluation uses 206 PR-pair tasks from 137 production-scale repositories across six languages, with three trials per configuration.
g6lX6r2LhO.claimed_gains: The best configuration resolves only about one-fifth of tasks on average over three trials, compared with over 80\% reported for leading systems on SWE-Bench Verified.

WRp9Klu5s7.one_liner: CacheRepair predicts all-token KV residuals to restore cross-chunk attention missing from independently prefilled retrieval caches.
WRp9Klu5s7.problem: Concatenated independent chunk caches lose cross-chunk context, while selective target-model recomputation incurs substantial online cost.
WRp9Klu5s7.method: A lightweight network combines compressed KV features and token embeddings with within-chunk bidirectional and cross-chunk causal attention. Trained for a frozen target LLM on a generic retrieval corpus, it adds predicted residuals to every document token's cache.
WRp9Klu5s7.key_idea: Learn the residual between independently prefilled and jointly processed caches and apply the correction to every document token.
WRp9Klu5s7.evidence: Experiments cover three target LLMs and four downstream datasets and analyze KV errors at chunk boundaries and interiors.
WRp9Klu5s7.claimed_gains: CacheRepair lies on the measured answer-quality–latency Pareto frontier in eleven of twelve model–dataset combinations.

9pWS6bKRRA.one_liner: Momentum estimators track nested function values and gradients for stochastic multilevel nonconvex compositional optimization.
9pWS6bKRRA.problem: Nested objectives make overall gradient estimation difficult when only stochastic function values and gradients are available at each level.
9pWS6bKRRA.method: The methods use mini-batch momentum estimators for level-wise function values and gradients, with normalization removing problem-dependent hyperparameter requirements. A batch-free variant combines first-order approximation and clipping for function-value estimation.
9pWS6bKRRA.key_idea: Track nested function values with momentum to construct gradient estimators, using normalization or clipped first-order approximations for alternative implementations.
9pWS6bKRRA.evidence: Sample-complexity analysis avoids average smoothness assumptions, and experiments address risk-averse portfolio optimization and hierarchical tilted empirical risk minimization.
9pWS6bKRRA.claimed_gains: The methods attain optimal $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4})$ sample complexity for an $\epsilon$-stationary point, including normalized and batch-free variants.

1ZmoD2kCbR.one_liner: ICCS combines instance- and cluster-level cross-clothing supervision for unsupervised person re-identification with sparse outfit variation.
1ZmoD2kCbR.problem: Unsupervised clothing-change re-identification assumes most training identities have multiple outfits, which many public scenarios cannot provide.
1ZmoD2kCbR.method: ICCS generates cross-clothing supervision at both instance and cluster levels for dense and sparse settings. Its instance-level random channel augmentation and random clothing fusion transform clothing regions to expose appearance variation.
1ZmoD2kCbR.key_idea: Combine instance- and cluster-level cross-clothing signals, with random channel augmentation and clothing fusion altering instance-level clothing appearance.

MJpc6VK8w2.one_liner: AxisPose++ transports a reference-anchored tri-axis coordinate frame and recovers object rotation through constrained geometric back-projection.
MJpc6VK8w2.problem: Single-reference rotation estimation is sensitive to occlusion, weak texture, and errors accumulated through intermediate synthesis or geometry predictions.
MJpc6VK8w2.method: AxisPose++ anchors the object coordinate frame to a posed RGB reference and transports its compact tri-axis structure to the target view. Back-projection enforces axis orthogonality and camera-projection consistency to recover rotation.
MJpc6VK8w2.key_idea: Transport a reference-anchored tri-axis frame to the target view, then recover rotation with orthogonality and camera-projection constraints.
MJpc6VK8w2.evidence: Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks evaluate generalization and compare speed with OrienPose.

Go6WmAmlqk.one_liner: EgoXR-GUI evaluates direct, spatial, and semantic GUI grounding in egocentric scenes combining digital overlays and physical context.
Go6WmAmlqk.problem: Desktop and mobile GUI benchmarks omit XR's physical-digital relationships, perspective distortion, hand occlusion, and cluttered backgrounds.
Go6WmAmlqk.method: EgoXR-GUI collects and annotates real-world XR scenarios for direct, spatial, and semantic grounding. It evaluates multimodal models on interactions requiring interpretation of digital interfaces within physical surroundings.
Go6WmAmlqk.key_idea: Ground digital GUI elements within real egocentric physical contexts using direct, spatial, and semantic task categories.
Go6WmAmlqk.evidence: The benchmark contains over 1,000 annotated samples and reports weaker model performance than conventional 2D grounding.

z95Ud55rtM.one_liner: Ego-Forge derives diffusion conditioning from hidden states and learns cross-view correspondence for exo-to-egocentric video generation.
z95Ud55rtM.problem: Existing exo-to-egocentric generators require extra observations or human captions and can incur costly, error-propagating geometry-guided attention.
z95Ud55rtM.method: Dynamic Captioning creates conditioning tokens from hidden states and adapts them to diffusion timestep and network depth. Expanded training using all available exocentric viewpoints learns cross-view correspondence without geometry-guided attention.
z95Ud55rtM.key_idea: Replace external captions with timestep- and depth-adaptive hidden-state conditioning while learning cross-view correspondence from expanded multiview training.
z95Ud55rtM.evidence: The TL;DR reports inference-speed and in-the-wild generalization results, but the supplied text does not specify evaluation datasets or protocols.

t96zhZ5syM.one_liner: TrajCFG sets token-wise classifier-free guidance scales from historical changes in guided velocity direction during flow-matching sampling.
t96zhZ5syM.problem: A shared classifier-free guidance scale ignores differences in how individual latent tokens' velocity predictions evolve.
t96zhZ5syM.method: TrajCFG combines adjacent-step and interval-normalized longer-span directional feedback and maps it to bounded token-wise guidance scales. Larger direction changes receive stronger guidance using existing CFG predictions without extra model evaluations.
t96zhZ5syM.key_idea: Fuse short- and long-span velocity-direction changes to assign bounded token-wise guidance scales during sampling.
t96zhZ5syM.evidence: Diagnostics, ablations, and experiments cover text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-audio-video, text-to-image, and image-to-3D generation across multiple backbones.
t96zhZ5syM.claimed_gains: Text-to-video VBench Total scores improve by 0.30--0.75 points over the strongest evaluated baseline on each of three backbones.

BeO6qVp75o.one_liner: SPIM alternates stochastic optimal control solves whose terminal costs implement Schrödinger-potential fixed-point iteration.
BeO6qVp75o.problem: Two-endpoint distribution constraints prevent direct application of terminal-cost stochastic optimal control solvers to Schrödinger bridges.
BeO6qVp75o.method: Each directional SOC solve uses the relative endpoint energy minus the opposite solve's initial-time value as terminal cost. Forward-backward solves implement potential propagation under the Cole–Hopf transform and extend to running state costs.
BeO6qVp75o.key_idea: Alternate directional SOC solves, setting each terminal cost from its endpoint energy and the opposite direction's initial-time value.
BeO6qVp75o.evidence: Under compactness and uniform kernel positivity, analysis establishes geometric convergence and a unique optimal bridge; experiments assess endpoint and interior transport accuracy.

zZTxv5Sv9h.one_liner: A Markov reward formulation trains speculative drafters by directly minimizing expected decoding rounds with temporal-difference gradients.
zZTxv5Sv9h.problem: Block-local drafter objectives ignore coupling between earlier token acceptance and later decoding-round starting positions.
zZTxv5Sv9h.method: The framework models speculative decoding as a Markov reward process and weights local rejection costs by state occupancies. It derives an exact temporal-difference gradient for unbiased optimization and an offline round-count evaluator using target-model rollouts.
zZTxv5Sv9h.key_idea: Weight local rejection costs by Markov state occupancy to obtain the exact expected-round objective and its temporal-difference gradient.
zZTxv5Sv9h.evidence: Theoretical derivations establish equality to expected decoding rounds, an unbiased stochastic gradient, and exact offline evaluation for parallel and semi-autoregressive drafters.

x0z1rw9dCK.one_liner: SOL compares distributions of Transformer hidden-state measures using double sliced Wasserstein distance to evaluate text generation.
x0z1rw9dCK.problem: Likelihood bounds vary in tightness across language-model families, while sample-based perplexity substitutes do not measure distribution fit.
x0z1rw9dCK.method: SOL represents each sequence as an empirical measure of hidden states from a fixed Transformer. It compares distributions of these measures through double sliced Wasserstein distance.
x0z1rw9dCK.key_idea: Treat each text sequence as a hidden-state empirical measure and compare distributions of those measures using double sliced Wasserstein distance.
x0z1rw9dCK.evidence: The paper proves metric validity for injective Transformers and re-evaluates OpenWebText-trained models, testing distributional failures, expected trends, and sample-estimate stability.

UKo155jelh.one_liner: Causal Lookahead Probing transplants hidden states to compare model answer commitment against a program-defined reasoning trajectory.
UKo155jelh.problem: Claims that models commit to answers before finishing their reasoning lack a procedural reference point and reliable causal measurement.
UKo155jelh.method: A task program defines how much each intermediate state can determine the answer. Parameter-free hidden-state transplantation tests when model answers follow another problem's state, locating commitment relative to this procedural bound.
UKo155jelh.key_idea: Transplant hidden states between problems and compare causal answer commitment with the information permitted by each step of a known program.
UKo155jelh.evidence: Validation uses program-compiled Transformers with known computation and experiments across four tasks and nine checkpoints up to 8B.
UKo155jelh.claimed_gains: The probe recovers compiled-model trajectories to within $0.006$ at every step, and reasoning-distilled models commit up to $2.21\times$ earlier than licensed on three tasks.

usmQueAMzt.one_liner: A comparative routing study tests whether scaling data and encoders overcomes routers' limited prediction of query-specific model correctness.
usmQueAMzt.problem: LLM routers converge to similar accuracy far below an oracle, suggesting inadequate instance-specific correctness prediction.
usmQueAMzt.method: The study compares diverse routing approaches and analyzes their shared failures and reliance on global model-performance trends. A larger query benchmark tests additional data, larger encoders, and end-to-end fine-tuning.
usmQueAMzt.key_idea: Compare router failure patterns and scaling interventions to distinguish global-average model selection from query-specific correctness prediction.
usmQueAMzt.evidence: The study evaluates 21 routing methods across five benchmarks and tests scaling on eight routers using a 300K-query benchmark.
usmQueAMzt.claimed_gains: More data, larger encoders, and end-to-end fine-tuning improve eight routers by 1.24 percentage points on average while leaving the plateau largely intact.

r4LVH0wwRB.one_liner: Stepwise Reward Augmentation combines intermediate normalized reward-gradient targets with on-policy self-distillation for few-step diffusion personalization.
r4LVH0wwRB.problem: Reference-conditioned self-distillation encourages subject fidelity and image quality only indirectly when personalizing few-step diffusion models.
r4LVH0wwRB.method: SRA constructs local targets from normalized reward gradients at intermediate denoising states and weights them using the sampling schedule. Aggregate gradient-norm balancing controls their strength against distillation, with detached rollout states avoiding backpropagation through sampling transitions.
r4LVH0wwRB.key_idea: Add schedule-weighted intermediate reward-gradient targets to teacher supervision and balance their aggregate gradient norm against the distillation objective.
r4LVH0wwRB.evidence: Object and style personalization experiments across two backbones include matched controls, alternative reward recipes, and training-cost comparisons.

3jNEVOP3OV.one_liner: A contrastive flow-matching surrogate optimizes offline forward-KL alignment using preferred and dispreferred samples.
3jNEVOP3OV.problem: Forward-process preference alignment requires fresh samples, while fixed-data methods mainly use positive-only training or likelihood-ratio surrogates.
3jNEVOP3OV.method: FlowCPO frames alignment through divergences and derives a contrastive flow-matching upper bound on forward KL for linear interpolation under explicit regularity conditions. It trains on fixed preferred and dispreferred samples without online rollouts.
3jNEVOP3OV.key_idea: Bound offline forward-KL alignment by a nonnegative contrastive flow-matching loss over preferred and dispreferred samples.
3jNEVOP3OV.evidence: Theory establishes the surrogate bound and nonnegativity, while in-domain and out-of-domain experiments evaluate GenEval, OCR, and reward metrics.
3jNEVOP3OV.claimed_gains: At CFG 3.0, in-domain GenEval and OCR scores reach 0.84 and 0.87 versus 0.81 and 0.74 for FlowDPO.

mMiQeizW6F.one_liner: Patch-specific test generation audits coding-agent solutions against prompt requirements beyond fixed unit tests.
mMiQeizW6F.problem: Fixed benchmark tests can accept patches that miss required behavior or exploit evaluator gaps.
mMiQeizW6F.method: TestJack generates tests for requirements a trial patch may violate, keeps tests passed by the ground-truth patch, and re-examines trial failures. A lighter variant audits sampled trials and reuses resulting tests across trials for each task.
mMiQeizW6F.key_idea: Generate requirement-targeted tests from observed patches, validate them against ground-truth patches, and replay confirmed failures.
mMiQeizW6F.evidence: Evaluation spans 6 frontier model backends and 5 benchmarks, including DeepSWE and SWE Marathon.

adsFLaMo2r.one_liner: Specialized language-model agents query CAD geometry with Python and rendered views to recover editable construction programs.
adsFLaMo2r.problem: CAD reverse engineering with language models faces scarce 3D alignment data and dependence on trained geometry encoders.
adsFLaMo2r.method: CADre equips frontier LLM agents with Python and a renderer to inspect shapes through textual measurements and images. Specialized agents investigate geometry, generate CAD programs, and verify results.
adsFLaMo2r.key_idea: Expose CAD structure through executable geometry queries and rendered images for agents that synthesize and verify construction programs.

MquqEN9kpr.one_liner: Fixed-prefix counterfactuals reward visual calls only when looking was needed and the returned pixels influenced the answer.
MquqEN9kpr.problem: Visual-tool rewards can pay for successful calls that neither provide necessary information nor use the returned pixels.
MquqEN9kpr.method: CounterCredit compares each realized visual branch with answering immediately and with substituting random same-size image patches. Calls passing both checks earn cashback, other executed calls pay bounded rent, and a dual-channel GRPO advantage separates the price signal.
MquqEN9kpr.key_idea: Compare visual calls against immediate answers and random-patch substitutions, rewarding only calls that pass both necessity and evidence-use checks.
MquqEN9kpr.evidence: Matched cold-start, prompt-pool, and budget comparisons evaluate V∗, HR-Bench-4K, and HR-Bench-8K against outcome-only GRPO.
MquqEN9kpr.claimed_gains: CounterCredit reaches 89.5%, 80.2%, and 76.4% on V∗, HR-Bench-4K, and HR-Bench-8K, respectively, gaining 6.3 to 9.4 points over outcome-only GRPO at 1.78 against 1.84 calls per question and lowering spurious calls to 31% to 36%.

pJo8TmWdVm.one_liner: Batch-parallel Monte Carlo Tree Search organizes neural evaluations for GPU scaling while retaining an approximate policy-improvement interpretation.
pJo8TmWdVm.problem: MCTS's sequential and deterministic structure makes principled scaling with parallel compute difficult.
pJo8TmWdVm.method: Particle MCTS provides a parallel search algorithm designed for batched neural-network evaluation and GPU acceleration. It retains MCTS's approximate policy-improvement interpretation while scaling inference-time computation.
pJo8TmWdVm.key_idea: Parallelize Monte Carlo Tree Search through batched neural evaluations while retaining its approximate policy-improvement interpretation.
pJo8TmWdVm.evidence: Experiments compare heuristic baselines across Chess, 19x19 Go, 9x9 Go, Gardner Chess, Snake, Brax control environments, and LLM reasoning in Sokoban.

GViTZhaurM.one_liner: A perceptual-semantic encoder selects video-diffusion computation, and a code-aware decoder reconstructs omitted generative information.
GViTZhaurM.problem: Video diffusion acceleration must reduce latency while preserving the native generator's visual quality, temporal consistency, and prompt fidelity.
GViTZhaurM.method: Coded computation combines bottom-up visual cues and text-prompt relevance into a time-varying compute code. A lightweight decoder uses that code and spatiotemporal and diffusion priors to reconstruct information omitted by selective computation.
GViTZhaurM.key_idea: Jointly encode which generative computations run and decode omitted information using the compute code and generative priors.
GViTZhaurM.evidence: Experiments compare visual quality, temporal consistency, and prompt fidelity with existing acceleration methods at comparable inference speeds; datasets and numerical results are not stated.

cwHY6wRCnn.one_liner: A cached noise estimate constructs a time-warped latent probe whose velocity adds contrastive guidance to CFG.
cwHY6wRCnn.method: TWiG augments classifier-free guidance with a contrastive term from a conditional prediction at a time-warped query. A cached Tweedie noise estimate constructs the query, and a calibration scalar with two clip bounds controls its time schedule.
cwHY6wRCnn.key_idea: Evaluate the conditional branch at a time-warped latent built from the previous step's noise estimate and add its contrastive velocity to CFG.
cwHY6wRCnn.evidence: Evaluation includes alignment analysis on five backbones, automatic quality and diversity metrics, GenEval and GenEval2, and a blinded pairwise human study across two evaluation backbones.

F1RkMDoiYC.one_liner: Controlled point-cloud edits test 3D grounding and provide counterfactual preference pairs for multimodal direct preference optimization.
F1RkMDoiYC.problem: 3D multimodal models can rely on language priors and dataset correlations while neglecting point-cloud evidence.
F1RkMDoiYC.method: CounterGround3D evaluates recolor, flip, add, remove, replace, and move interventions using paired sensitivity, edited-scene accuracy, and irrelevant-edit invariance tests. Its m^2DPO framework uses counterfactual pairs as mixed multimodal preference supervision.
F1RkMDoiYC.key_idea: Intervene on point-cloud attributes and objects, then use counterfactual pairs both to test grounding sensitivity and to train preference-based corrections.
F1RkMDoiYC.evidence: Experiments across multiple 3D LMMs reveal grounding failures hidden by conventional benchmarks and evaluate improvements from m^2DPO.

wpCptlcHSy.one_liner: A reusable morphology bank fuses with independently retrieved question-specific patches into a fixed visual prefix for slide question answering.
wpCptlcHSy.problem: Question-guided patch selection can omit supporting morphology, while whole-slide compression can dilute focal evidence.
wpCptlcHSy.method: BeyondPath learns a question-independent Morphology Bank through supervision across multiple questions per slide and retrieves question-specific evidence from all foreground patches. Morphology-on-Visual-Evidence Fusion integrates both at retrieved positions to produce a fixed 96-token prefix.
wpCptlcHSy.key_idea: Preserve morphology across questions, independently retrieve relevant foreground patches, and fuse bank information at the retrieved evidence positions.
wpCptlcHSy.evidence: Experiments use WSI-Bench and zero-shot SlideBench-BCNB, with ablations testing morphology preservation, question-directed retrieval, cross-question supervision, and fusion positions.
wpCptlcHSy.claimed_gains: BeyondPath achieves an Avg-9 of 0.769 on WSI-Bench, leads all eight reported report-generation metrics with the same checkpoint, and reaches 0.639 zero-shot overall accuracy on SlideBench-BCNB.

wUmx9uhfE5.one_liner: Structured claims carry evidence pointers and quantities that enable verification and repair before paper-to-video rendering.
wUmx9uhfE5.problem: Polished paper-to-video presentations can contain unsupported or contradictory claims that presentation-quality metrics overlook.
wUmx9uhfE5.method: PRESENTFAITH compares recovered video claims with a fine-grained source-paper Evidence Index. EVI-IR stores claim types, evidence pointers, and quantities, checks their links where possible, and repairs unsupported or inconsistent claims before rendering.
wUmx9uhfE5.key_idea: Represent each presentation claim with its type, source-evidence pointer, and quantities so validation and repair occur before video rendering.
wUmx9uhfE5.evidence: Experiments on PRESENTFAITH evaluate claim faithfulness and supported claims per minute against the strongest baseline.
wUmx9uhfE5.claimed_gains: EVI-IR reduces the unfaithful claim rate from 17.6% to 12.5% and increases supported claims per minute from 11.7 to 13.6.

mmV9xVxNO5.one_liner: A five-stage pipeline audit and standardized evaluation harness expose interacting failures in cybersecurity LLM benchmarks.
mmV9xVxNO5.problem: Cybersecurity benchmark scores and model rankings can reflect evaluation-pipeline failures and choices rather than model capability alone.
mmV9xVxNO5.method: The study audits each benchmark as a five-stage measurement pipeline and identifies recurring failure modes and their interactions. A standardized evaluation harness tests the combined effects of pipeline choices.
mmV9xVxNO5.key_idea: Audit and standardize interacting evaluation stages jointly because changing one stage can alter the effects of another.
mmV9xVxNO5.evidence: The audit covers eight cybersecurity benchmarks and 10 proprietary, open-weight, and cybersecurity-specialized LLMs, including SecEval budget and answer-extractor interventions.
mmV9xVxNO5.claimed_gains: The audit identifies 14 recurring failure modes, individual inference or scoring failures can shift scores by more than 80 percentage points, and standardization yields 11 shifts of at least three ranks excluding failed and near-chance runs.

ELYDJS47h6.one_liner: A cumulative task summary and chronological event index preserve compact agent memory with optional retrieval of immutable source records.
ELYDJS47h6.problem: Long agent histories exceed context windows, while compressed summaries lose provenance and chunk retrieval lacks explicit trajectory structure.
ELYDJS47h6.method: DyadMem separates Situation Memory, a cumulative task-state summary, from an Event List whose stable identifiers point to immutable raw records. Hierarchical recompression preserves identifier coverage, and agents can verify draft answers through search, identifier-based reading, and focused rereading.
ELYDJS47h6.key_idea: Pair a cumulative task summary with a chronological index of stable identifiers linked to immutable raw events.
ELYDJS47h6.evidence: CAME-Bench and AMA-Bench evaluations use Gemma-4-31B and Qwen3-32B and compare DyadMem with nine baselines.
ELYDJS47h6.claimed_gains: DyadMem achieves 76.17% and 64.29% F1 on CAME-Bench with Gemma-4-31B and Qwen3-32B, respectively, and 67.75% and 66.15% accuracy on AMA-Bench.

dJPDD57Bug.one_liner: Scaled gradients, symmetric hard thresholding, and joint line search estimate sparse and latent Gaussian graphical components.
dJPDD57Bug.problem: Unequal latent-effect strengths can slow gradient descent even when the observed precision matrix remains well-conditioned.
dJPDD57Bug.method: The method combines scaled gradient descent with symmetric hard thresholding and a joint feasibility-and-descent line search. A thresholded spectral initializer has sufficient conditions for support recovery and entry into the local convergence neighborhood.
dJPDD57Bug.key_idea: Scale low-rank gradient updates while jointly enforcing sparse thresholding, feasibility, and descent for the sparse-plus-latent decomposition.
dJPDD57Bug.evidence: At the correct rank, analysis bounds separate component errors with latent-eigenvalue-independent contraction under fixed precision conditioning and transversality; simulations compare ScaledGD, gradient descent, and AltGD.

1N1jF8NZod.one_liner: Temporal context and repeated camera observations refine shared geometry while correspondence-guided Gaussians propagate across streaming frames.
1N1jF8NZod.problem: Changing visual evidence destabilizes camera and depth predictions in sparse uncalibrated views, causing geometric jitter and rendering flicker.
1N1jF8NZod.method: CoSTA4D combines anchor-context temporal aggregation with reliability-aware camera refinement to accumulate evidence about fixed capture geometry. Correspondence-guided Gaussian propagation maintains frame continuity using current and past observations without per-sequence optimization.
1N1jF8NZod.key_idea: Aggregate historical context, refine shared camera estimates from repeated observations, and propagate Gaussians through correspondences across frames.
1N1jF8NZod.evidence: Experiments on DNA-Rendering and self-captured videos evaluate reconstruction quality and temporal consistency.

upRkqqCxHB.one_liner: Evidence graphs check whether scientific agents' claims agree with their computations, figures, and written interpretations.
upRkqqCxHB.problem: Correct final claims can conceal contradictory analysis or incomplete supporting evidence in scientific coding-agent runs.
upRkqqCxHB.method: SCIRIGOR links claims to numerical results, plotted comparisons, and interpretations in an evidence graph. Its evaluator checks reference requirements and cross-artifact agreement, limiting claim support by the weakest required check while accepting approved alternatives.
upRkqqCxHB.key_idea: Connect claims to computational and visual evidence, then bound each claim's support by its weakest required verification check.
upRkqqCxHB.evidence: The benchmark contains 100 cases from 27 articles across six domains and 17 subfields, evaluated with eight model–runner configurations.
upRkqqCxHB.claimed_gains: The evaluator finds incomplete support in 64 of 357 submissions with perfect final-claim scores; the highest Path F1 is 84.4%, and no configuration exceeds 40.8% Strict success.

opK3mPSu1e.one_liner: Video-conditioned diffusion generates humanoid reference motions, then tracking-feedback preference optimization improves their executability.
opK3mPSu1e.problem: Separately optimized reconstruction, retargeting, and tracking stages limit scalability and cannot directly use tracking feedback to optimize reference-motion executability.
opK3mPSu1e.method: ViT-H generates humanoid reference motions directly from monocular videos with a diffusion model and post-trains it through direct preference optimization using motion-tracking outcomes. An autoregressive variant supports real-time video teleoperation.
opK3mPSu1e.key_idea: Use downstream motion-tracking outcomes as preference feedback to post-train a video-conditioned humanoid-motion diffusion model.
opK3mPSu1e.evidence: Unitree G1 experiments compare reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines and examine scaling with model size, training data, and different motion trackers.
opK3mPSu1e.claimed_gains: The autoregressive variant enables humanoid video teleoperation with sub-500 ms latency.

AcnGoegpmS.one_liner: MLLM-derived spatial priors and semantic descriptions guide memory fusion and query features for few-shot segmentation.
AcnGoegpmS.problem: Appearance-based support-query matching struggles with appearance discrepancies and occlusion because it lacks sufficient target knowledge.
AcnGoegpmS.method: MK-FSS builds on SAM 2 and extracts spatial and semantic target knowledge from the query image with an MLLM. It fuses spatial-prior memory with support-guided memory through dual-memory debate-fusion and combines text features with multi-scale query features.
AcnGoegpmS.key_idea: Fuse MLLM-derived spatial memory with support-guided memory while injecting target descriptions into multi-scale query features.

fjfeXdBS5s.one_liner: Hindsight distillation trains small sentinels to choose pre-execution interventions and provide actionable feedback for coding agents.
fjfeXdBS5s.problem: Coding agents lack reliable pre-execution judgments about whether an intervention will improve eventual task completion.
fjfeXdBS5s.method: HiSentinel distills a teacher's outcome-informed intervention judgments into 0.6B and 1.7B students that see only pre-action context and proposed actions. SWE-Intervene labels software-engineering actions for allowance, autonomous redirection, or human assistance and supplies corresponding feedback.
fjfeXdBS5s.key_idea: Distill intervention judgments based on recorded future outcomes into a causal sentinel restricted to pre-action information.
fjfeXdBS5s.evidence: The abstract names evaluations on SWE-bench Verified Mini and Ask or Assume but truncates their results.

quaxEhvUVQ.one_liner: Controls voice timbre and lip sync in joint audio-video generation via time-uniform AdaLN modulation and face-localized reward steering.
quaxEhvUVQ.problem: Joint talking audio-video generators leak time-varying content when injecting reference voice into the token stream, unsettling lip synchronization while leaving timbre poorly controlled under reconstruction losses alone.
quaxEhvUVQ.method: VESTA injects a reference speaker embedding uniformly across time via audio-branch AdaLN channel modulation (StatShift) and adds perceptual supervision via a timbre reward and a noise-aware lip-sync critic scored on face-localized one-step decodes (RewardSteer). An optional test-time optimization step (TimbreTune) handles difficult out-of-tail speakers.
quaxEhvUVQ.key_idea: Modulates audio channel statistics uniformly across time with a speaker embedding while applying timbre rewards and a face-localized noise-aware lip-sync critic on one-step predictions.
quaxEhvUVQ.evidence: Evaluated on the open-source EMTD talking audio-video generation benchmark.
quaxEhvUVQ.claimed_gains: On the EMTD benchmark, raises reference-timbre similarity by nearly 50%, from 0.40 to 0.60.

BHt0UhGcAn.one_liner: Derives discrete activation-crossing expansions and mask-preservation radii to predict finite-radius hard-ReLU gradient-descent sensitivity beyond infinitesimal autodiff.
BHt0UhGcAn.problem: Infinitesimal automatic differentiation and continuous-flow sensitivity miss discrete step-rounding phase shifts when hard-ReLU initializations differ at radii proportional to the gradient-descent step size.
BHt0UhGcAn.method: The authors derive integer ReLU crossing steps for piecewise-C² gradient-descent dynamics with separated transverse events, accounting for Euler discretization shifts and cascading step-rounding effects. They also derive directional mask-preservation radii and finite-remainder bounds to certify candidate outer-loss ordering in contractive affine regions.
BHt0UhGcAn.key_idea: Tracks Euler clock shifts and discrete step-rounding propagation across transverse ReLU boundary crossings to expand finite-radius trained states and certify mask-preserving perturbation radii.
BHt0UhGcAn.evidence: Supported by theoretical proofs establishing uniform O(η²) trained-state prediction error away from step-rounding boundaries, alongside scalar, coupled, and small-network experiments.

72CFXOACMa.one_liner: Benchmarks embodied LLM agents across failure-grounded selective questioning, oracle-backed human answering, and answer-conditioned recovery on failed ALFRED trajectories.
72CFXOACMa.problem: Embodied agents lack unified benchmarks built from real autonomous execution failures to evaluate closed-loop selective help-seeking and answer-conditioned trajectory recovery.
72CFXOACMa.method: Recovery through Selective Questioning (ReSQ) compiles 2,160 failure-grounded question demonstrations from 678 failed ALFRED trajectories (ReSQ-Q), 6,480 human responses with a reproducible response oracle (ReSQ-A), and answer-conditioned recovery trajectories (ReSQ-R). It evaluates and supervises LLM agents across questioning timing, response utilization, and recovery.
72CFXOACMa.key_idea: Constructs paired question demonstrations, a human-response oracle, and answer-conditioned recovery trajectories directly from real failed autonomous ALFRED rollouts.
72CFXOACMa.evidence: Constructed from 678 failed ALFRED trajectories (2,160 questions and 6,480 human responses) and evaluated across diverse LLM families and model scales under question and recovery supervision.

PDNdO1i2if.one_liner: Generates view-aligned sparse 3D voxels from unposed images via first-frame canonicalization, joint-reconstruction dual-tower DiTs, and pixel-to-voxel attention priors.
PDNdO1i2if.problem: Coarse-stage sparse structure generators in image-to-3D pipelines exhibit uncontrollable orientation from ambiguous semantic canonicalization and unfaithful geometry from weak 2D-3D grounding.
PDNdO1i2if.method: Coarse3D anchors canonical coordinates to the first input view while preserving object-centric normalization, and trains a dual-tower Diffusion Transformer coupling sparse voxel generation with auxiliary feed-forward reconstruction. It further regularizes cross-attention with explicit pixel-to-voxel spatial correspondence priors.
PDNdO1i2if.key_idea: Combines first-view-anchored canonical coordinates, a dual-tower DiT coupling generation with feed-forward reconstruction, and pixel-to-voxel cross-attention regularization for sparse 3D voxel generation.
PDNdO1i2if.evidence: Evaluated as a drop-in replacement for the coarse sparse-structure generation stage in existing coarse-to-fine image-to-3D pipelines.

PRKS257nfI.one_liner: Represents world-action trajectories as knot-adapted cubic B-splines with knot-aligned video supervision and Jacobian-pullback real-time chunk continuity.
PRKS257nfI.problem: Fixed-length action chunking in World-Action Models allocates inference compute uniformly over time rather than adapting execution horizons between free-space motion and contact-rich manipulation.
PRKS257nfI.method: SplineWAM compresses action trajectories into a fixed-size window of cubic B-spline parameters with motion-fitted knot times—decoding into variable-duration action chunks—while aligning future-video supervision to those fitted knots. For asynchronous execution, Jacobian-Pullback Real-Time Chunking (JP-RTC) enforces raw-action prefix continuity by correcting spline parameters through the decoder.
PRKS257nfI.key_idea: Fits motion-adaptive cubic B-spline knots for variable-duration action chunks, aligns future-video supervision to those knots, and enforces raw-action prefix continuity via decoder Jacobian pullback.
PRKS257nfI.evidence: Evaluated on LIBERO-Plus and RoboCasa robot manipulation benchmarks against a fixed-horizon action-chunking World-Action Model.

92wR5Pdyja.one_liner: Defines mirror sharpness relative to mirror potentials and derives a dual central-flow ODE for edge-of-stability mirror descent.
92wR5Pdyja.problem: Existing Euclidean explanations for why gradient-descent Hessian sharpness stabilizes around 2/η at the edge of stability do not extend to non-Euclidean mirror descent.
92wR5Pdyja.method: The authors generalize sharpness to mirror sharpness—measuring loss curvature with respect to the mirror potential—and empirically show it hovers slightly above 2/η. They derive a continuous-time dual central-flow ODE modeling mirror-descent iterates at edge-of-stability onset to characterize obstacles to extending Euclidean stabilization proofs.
92wR5Pdyja.key_idea: Measures loss curvature with respect to the mirror potential via mirror sharpness and models continuous-time iterate trajectories at edge-of-stability onset using a dual central-flow ODE.
92wR5Pdyja.evidence: Supported by empirical tracking of mirror sharpness near the 2/η threshold and theoretical derivation of the continuous-time dual central-flow ODE.

7vEGVhQ221.one_liner: Infers client class frequencies from local-to-global prototype cosine alignment in federated learning and defends via orthogonal prototype perturbations.
7vEGVhQ221.problem: Shared per-class feature prototypes in heterogeneous federated learning leak client label distributions because local prototypes align more strongly in angle with global prototypes for more frequent local classes.
7vEGVhQ221.method: The authors propose the Prototype-Based Label Distribution Inference Attack (PLIA) to infer client class distributions from cosine alignment between shared local and global prototypes. To mitigate this leakage, Directional Prototype Perturbation (DPP) injects orthogonal directional perturbations with randomized per-class budgets into shared prototypes.
7vEGVhQ221.key_idea: Exploits angular cosine alignment between local and global class prototypes to infer client label distributions and disrupts this signal using randomized-budget orthogonal perturbations.
7vEGVhQ221.evidence: Evaluated PLIA and DPP across five federated learning benchmark datasets against baseline label-distribution inference attacks.

HgJmkOenSI.one_liner: Detects AI-generated images by measuring single-image 3D point-normal consistency alongside reference-relative depth and point deviations with margin supervision.
HgJmkOenSI.problem: Image-domain 2D cues for AI-generated image detection are generator-dependent and degrade under resizing and recompression during online dissemination.
HgJmkOenSI.method: GeoCue extracts 3D geometric coherence signals from a single image using a frozen geometry predictor, combining agreement between predicted 3D-point normals and surface normals with reference-relative depth and 3D point deviations. It adapts a cue predictor over these discrepancies via a margin-based objective with real/fake supervision.
HgJmkOenSI.key_idea: Extracts discrepancies between 3D-point-implied normals and predicted surface normals alongside reference-relative depth and point deviations from a frozen geometry predictor under margin-based supervision.
HgJmkOenSI.evidence: Evaluated across unseen-generator benchmarks and in-the-wild online-dissemination benchmarks using mean AUC.

mOBlI56vrI.one_liner: Stabilizes RL fine-tuning of sparse-MoE diffusion VLAs via negative-advantage noise-scaled load balancing and geometric-mean trajectory likelihood ratios.
mOBlI56vrI.problem: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning of diffusion vision-language-action policies with sparse MoE action heads destabilizes due to advantage-dependent expert routing concentration at low noise and heavy-tailed accumulated denoising likelihood ratios.
mOBlI56vrI.method: The authors introduce Advantage- and Noise-Aware Load Balancing (ANA-LB) to apply noise-scaled expert load balancing exclusively on negative group-relative advantage trajectories, preserving specialization on positive-advantage samples. They pair this with Geometric-Mean Ratio (GMR) to aggregate step-wise denoising log-ratios without severe trajectory-ratio clipping.
mOBlI56vrI.key_idea: Apply noise-scaled expert load balancing solely to negative-advantage trajectories and replace accumulated denoising-step likelihood ratios with their geometric mean.
mOBlI56vrI.evidence: Supported by empirical routing/ratio diagnostics and local gradient analysis on sparse-MoE diffusion VLAs, while benchmark results are truncated in the abstract.

FrJ34U1nbq.one_liner: Partitions user history by semantic concentration into offline PEFT for core data and online RAG for peripheral queries.
FrJ34U1nbq.problem: Applying PEFT, RAG, or uniform PEFT+RAG to personalized LLMs ignores heterogeneous semantic density in user histories, trading off generation quality against retrieval latency.
FrJ34U1nbq.method: PEFT Union RAG (PUR) partitions each user's historical data by semantic concentration, encoding dense core data via offline parameter-efficient fine-tuning while storing dispersed data for retrieval. At inference, core queries are answered directly by the PEFT model and RAG is invoked only for peripheral queries.
FrJ34U1nbq.key_idea: Split personal historical data by semantic density so offline PEFT handles concentrated core queries directly while RAG serves dispersed peripheral queries.
FrJ34U1nbq.evidence: Empirical evaluation on personalized LLM accuracy and inference latency is referenced in the abstract, with specific benchmark details truncated.

1bhqIZcbQ5.one_liner: Screens ranking-influential records and applies sequence-level calibration with constrained top-K selection to bound item promotion in frozen LLM recommenders.
1bhqIZcbQ5.problem: Adversaries can manipulate item descriptions and interaction histories in LLM recommenders to repeatedly over-promote targeted items, and heuristic filtering lacks statistical guarantees on residual promotion.
1bhqIZcbQ5.method: CREST screens suspicious records by comparing their joint ranking influence against historical baselines, then uses sequence-level calibration to bound residual promotion risk. A constrained top-K selection procedure optimizes recommendation utility while keeping each item's promotion rate below a user-specified threshold and confidence level.
1bhqIZcbQ5.key_idea: Screen records by joint ranking influence and calibrate residual promotion across decision sequences to constrain per-item promotion rates during top-K selection.
1bhqIZcbQ5.evidence: Derives an exact worst-case promotion risk characterization and sequence-level exchangeability guarantees (empirical benchmarks are truncated in the abstract).

cUPhJCRrYk.one_liner: Compiles multi-LLM discussions into support-attack argumentation graphs that admit edge-removal counterfactual diagnostics and external consensus alignment.
cUPhJCRrYk.problem: Multi-expert LLM debate systems rely on voting or opaque aggregation, obscuring which specific arguments drove the final consensus.
cUPhJCRrYk.method: ARGORA compiles multi-LLM discussions into explicit support-and-attack argumentation graphs evaluated by a deterministic structural aggregation model that supports edge-local counterfactual removals. It also includes a correction mechanism to align internal graph consensus with external judgments when disagreements arise.
cUPhJCRrYk.key_idea: Aggregate multi-LLM debates over explicit support-and-attack graphs where edge-local removals identify decisive argument chains and align consensus.
cUPhJCRrYk.evidence: Evaluated across multiple accuracy benchmarks and an open-ended use case analyzing corrective consensus resolution under initial expert disagreement.

3H8KG3oCht.one_liner: Benchmarks workflow-driven repository file retrieval for coding agents across four next-step context tasks plus no-gold and counterfactual controls.
3H8KG3oCht.problem: End-to-end patch benchmarks obscure upstream repository file discovery failures, while standard semantic code search misses what coding agents need next in multi-step workflows.
3H8KG3oCht.method: Agent Retrieval Bench curates 427 file-level retrieval samples across 25 repositories at frozen commits spanning code2test, comment2context, trace2code, and edit2ripple tasks, alongside natural no-gold and counterfactual selective retrieval controls.
3H8KG3oCht.key_idea: Evaluate repository file retrieval by next-step agent context needs across code-to-test, comment-to-context, trace-to-code, and edit-ripple tasks with selective no-gold controls.
3H8KG3oCht.evidence: Evaluates lexical, dense embedding, and RepoMap retrievers, logged coding-agent trajectories across 427 samples, and a 45-sample pilot seeding agents with retrieved files.
3H8KG3oCht.claimed_gains: Logged agent trajectories miss all gold files on 27-35% of samples, while retrieval-derived seeds in a 45-sample pilot achieve higher final File F1 with fewer post-seed calls and read tokens than random non-gold seeds.

V6V2zdSZ2v.one_liner: Watermarks autoregressive LLM time-series forecasts in numerical value space using secret-keyed bands and feedback-free unmarked history steering.
V6V2zdSZ2v.problem: Token-level LLM watermarks break under numerical post-processing of probabilistic time-series forecasts such as rounding or subsampling, and autoregressive watermark edits compound errors across future steps.
V6V2zdSZ2v.method: V-band uses a secret key to partition each forecast step into numerical bands and tilts conditional digit probabilities toward preferred bands while conditioning lower-order digits on released higher-order digits. Value-feedback-free steering feeds unmarked history into subsequent autoregressive steps so watermark perturbations do not propagate.
V6V2zdSZ2v.key_idea: Tilt conditional digit probabilities toward secret-keyed numerical bands while preserving unmarked forecast history across autoregressive steps to prevent error propagation.
V6V2zdSZ2v.evidence: Proposes generation-time value-space watermarking and direct numerical verification for frozen autoregressive LLM forecasters (empirical details are truncated in the abstract).

SwPke4VyfO.one_liner: Controls finite-budget agentic plan graphs by scaling breadth to difficulty, pricing re-plan divergence tests, and solving priced path ILPs.
SwPke4VyfO.problem: Cost-blind structured planners for LLM agents can exhaust finite token and dollar budgets on preparatory planning and repeated re-planning before producing an answer.
SwPke4VyfO.method: DECAF builds a budget-aware plan-graph planner that scales initial plan breadth to observed task difficulty, gates re-planning with a priced divergence test, and selects execution routes via a priced graph integer linear program favoring the cheapest goal-reaching path.
SwPke4VyfO.key_idea: Couple difficulty-scaled plan breadth, priced divergence-gated re-planning, and integer-linear-programming selection of the lowest-cost goal-reaching path under a token budget.
SwPke4VyfO.evidence: Evaluated against structured and plan-graph planners across five agentic benchmarks on accuracy-cost trade-offs.

v3smWCBU2i.one_liner: Frozen language-model representations drive unified corpus retrieval and long-context evidence selection.
v3smWCBU2i.problem: Long-context inference and retrieval-augmented generation use different evidence-selection mechanisms despite operating at different scales of the same task.
v3smWCBU2i.method: UNREAL encodes chunks and derives retrieval queries directly from a frozen LLM's internal representations, adding fewer than 500K trainable parameters. The same mechanism retrieves corpus chunks and removes long-context distractors before generation.
v3smWCBU2i.key_idea: Derive both corpus queries and in-context evidence selection from the frozen language model's own internal representations.
v3smWCBU2i.evidence: Four dense and hybrid backbones are tested on a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index, multi-hop retrieval datasets, NoLiMa, and LV-Eval.
v3smWCBU2i.claimed_gains: The best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue, while NoLiMa accuracy rises from 1.0% to 24.83% at 128K tokens and LV-Eval F1 from 49.97% to 54.66% at 256K.

cUE9hPsFcQ.one_liner: Feature-level definitions and interventions distinguish memorization from generalization and label memorization.
cUE9hPsFcQ.problem: Deep learning lacks a clear feature-level distinction between memorization and generalization and an account of their interaction with label memorization.
cUE9hPsFcQ.method: The paper defines feature memorization and feature generalization and specifies conditions under which each occurs. It then investigates their interactions with label memorization through feature and label interventions.
cUE9hPsFcQ.key_idea: Separate feature memorization from feature generalization before analyzing how label memorization changes each phenomenon.
cUE9hPsFcQ.evidence: The stated analysis finds that label memorization suppresses feature memorization while causing feature generalization.

gSzB27MDTc.one_liner: Query-guided joint allocation selects cache-repair targets and sparse recomputation contexts for reuse.
gSzB27MDTc.problem: Position-independent KV chunks lack cross-chunk interactions, and existing repair methods use costly full causal-prefix recomputation contexts.
gSzB27MDTc.method: RelaxKV identifies layer-specific repair targets using the user query and restricts recomputation to query-relevant context. It jointly allocates the repair budget across target states and their recomputation contexts.
gSzB27MDTc.key_idea: Jointly choose which cached states to repair and which query-relevant tokens participate in their recomputation.
gSzB27MDTc.evidence: Experiments cover four decoder models, LongBench, Qwen3-14B anchor-ratio sweeps, RULER-MV, LV-Eval, and controlled recomputation-context ablations.
gSzB27MDTc.claimed_gains: At a 15% anchor ratio, RelaxKV improves aggregate LongBench performance over ProphetKV on all four decoder models.

K0M3MjbrI8.one_liner: Codec-inspired complexity measures allocate adaptive token budgets for discrete video generation.
K0M3MjbrI8.problem: Fixed-budget video tokenizers assign identical token counts to clips with different spatiotemporal complexity, wasting capacity and decoding compute.
K0M3MjbrI8.method: CodecTok estimates spatial complexity from block-wise gradients and temporal complexity from Hadamard-domain inter-frame residuals using a training-free allocator. A padding-free backbone with sequence packing and 3D rotary embeddings supports variable lengths, while semantic alignment distills a frozen video foundation model.
K0M3MjbrI8.key_idea: Use inexpensive spatial and temporal complexity statistics to set each clip's discrete token budget without allocation training or search.
K0M3MjbrI8.evidence: No completed experiments are stated in the provided abstract.

c3vafBCFbc.one_liner: Introduces EgoCrash synthetic driving-accident dataset and MRA-VLM for open-vocabulary egocentric video-text retrieval.
c3vafBCFbc.problem: Fine-grained egocentric traffic accident understanding lacks large-scale diverse data and struggles to generalize to unseen event categories and real-world videos.
c3vafBCFbc.method: They create EgoCrash (20,000 synthetic videos across 56 categories) and propose MRA-VLM, combining RGB and optical-flow cues with seen-event prototype retrieval and uncertainty-guided score fusion.
c3vafBCFbc.key_idea: Fuses RGB and optical-flow video representations with seen-event prototype retrieval and uncertainty-guided score fusion.
c3vafBCFbc.evidence: Evaluated on EgoCrash across seen events, category-disjoint unseen events, and real-world accident videos.

yd70iWnbPO.one_liner: Proposes PCSD, weighting token-level self-distillation by local persistence and trend of teacher-favoring signals during GRPO.
yd70iWnbPO.problem: On-policy self-distillation for multi-turn LLM agents suffers from noisy isolated token discrepancies or coarse shared step-level weights.
yd70iWnbPO.method: PCSD aggregates teacher-favoring signals across adaptive windows with exponential decay, applies trend-aware modulation to attenuate declining support, gates weights via sigmoid, and optimizes jointly with GRPO.
yd70iWnbPO.key_idea: Computes sigmoid-gated token distillation weights from exponentially decayed local persistence and trend of teacher support.
yd70iWnbPO.evidence: Evaluated on ALFWorld (including unseen split) and WebShop across two backbones against GRPO and SDAR.
yd70iWnbPO.claimed_gains: Exceeds GRPO by 15.6 and 13.3 points and SDAR by 6.2 and 5.5 points on ALFWorld Overall across two backbones, and gains 15.8 points over GRPO on the unseen ALFWorld split.

qZRyAC3tbK.one_liner: Presents EWAM, a unified embodied model with asymmetric joint attention exhibiting emergent depth-wise specialization.
qZRyAC3tbK.problem: Embodied systems combining semantic VLAs and predictive world models often concentrate action computation in a single expert without structured handoff.
qZRyAC3tbK.method: EWAM uses asymmetric joint attention so action tokens read semantic, current-visual, predicted-future, and action representations at every layer while perceptual experts remain separate, pretrained on robot trajectories and human egocentric video.
qZRyAC3tbK.key_idea: Asymmetric joint attention lets action queries shift attention across depth from vision-language to predicted future frames to actions without layer-wise supervision.
qZRyAC3tbK.evidence: Checkpoint tracking, causal interventions, and simulation and real-robot experiments comparing against VLA, WAM, and hybrid baselines.

rDBLCxYYB0.one_liner: Replaces neural query encoders in LLM routing with 128 SAE-discovered regular-expression features.
rDBLCxYYB0.problem: Neural LLM routers incur encoding latency and lack interpretability, while scaling Qwen2.5 encoders from 0.5B to 72B yields minimal routing accuracy gains.
rDBLCxYYB0.method: RegexRoute groups sparse autoencoder latents on unlabeled text, uses an LLM to translate and refine their descriptions into regex extractors, and feeds the resulting numerical features to a lightweight routing head.
rDBLCxYYB0.key_idea: Distills grouped sparse autoencoder latents into regular-expression extractors to supply routing features without neural encoding at inference.
rDBLCxYYB0.evidence: Evaluated across four LLM routing benchmarks using a fixed set of 128 regex features against neural text encoder baselines.
rDBLCxYYB0.claimed_gains: Achieves 76.43% average routing accuracy across four benchmarks with 128 regex features, comparable to 76.41% for the strongest neural text encoder baseline.

Alfqv8DR6O.one_liner: Introduces MeMoREval, a benchmark evaluating visual and spatial memory modalities for embodied LLM agents.
Alfqv8DR6O.problem: Embodied agents can store past experience as text, frames, or scene graphs, affecting task success and inference cost, but lack controlled cross-modality benchmarks.
Alfqv8DR6O.method: MeMoREval runs an experience-request protocol over 53 tasks in four simulated indoor environments, measuring task success and memory write/read inference costs across modalities.
Alfqv8DR6O.key_idea: Evaluates embodied memory modalities under a controlled blind experience-then-request protocol measuring both task success and inference cost.
Alfqv8DR6O.evidence: Reference evaluations across multiple models on 53 tasks in four simulated indoor environments plus two physical-robot demonstrations.

L9X4O4FNkF.one_liner: Derives flow-policy tilting and action editing from one proximal objective with a Wasserstein-smoothed KL regularizer.
L9X4O4FNkF.problem: Online RL for flow policies is costly in interaction data and multi-step generation, and prior tilting or editing methods ignore that low-value samples may become high-value after editing.
L9X4O4FNkF.method: SFEdit derives an exact tilt-transport factorization from a proximal policy-improvement objective with a Wasserstein-smoothed KL regularizer, realizing the tilt via adjoint matching. It also introduces iQAM, an integrating-factor discretization that avoids extra vector-Jacobian products in few-step learning.
L9X4O4FNkF.key_idea: Factorizes flow-policy improvement into value-after-editing tilting via adjoint matching and proximal action transport, discretized with iQAM.
L9X4O4FNkF.evidence: Evaluated on 50 OGBench tasks across ten domains (online and offline-to-online) and two fine-grained real-robot manipulation tasks.
L9X4O4FNkF.claimed_gains: Sets the highest final aggregate success across 50 OGBench tasks and nearly triples the success of a frozen policy on two real-robot manipulation tasks.

KolakFzUpK.one_liner: Accelerates memory-limited edge LLM inference via CATS using self-speculative cascaded tree verification matched to device offloading patterns.
KolakFzUpK.problem: Standard speculative decoding assumes sufficient memory to hold both a target and draft model, which fails on memory-constrained edge devices.
